label: REQ-002 validated: one-pass verdict protocol confirmed by Anthropic's 'prefer general instructions' + self-check lines and by christabone's 10-technique present/benefit/apply checklist with 1-2 sentence rationale; checklist membership is a design choice (its list has variables/CoT/task-decomposition, lacks success-criteria/contradictions/model-fit).

REQ-003 validated by two independent pass-throughs: severity1's ~189-token eval passes clear prompts with zero skill overhead (asks 1-6 questions only on vague), OpenAI meta-prompt's 'Minimal Changes' clause, and christabone's ban on over-engineering + per-technique 'Skip if' rows.

REQ-004 validated with a boundary caveat: vendor improvers ask nothing and the sibling's deliver-first+open-items matches; severity1's evaluate-then-pass-or-ask is a legitimate third model ('only ask when genuinely unclear; never block') to name as the alternative.

REQ-008 validated: OpenAI's meta-prompt emits one fixed skeleton (instruction -> details -> #Steps -> #Output Format -> #Examples -> #Notes); no vendor names acronym frameworks; keep seven names as internal labels at most. Acceptance criterion should target SKILL.md §3 + patterns-evaluation §2, not framework-registry.json (benchmark scaffold).

REQ-009 mostly validated but '3 to 5 examples' is too confident: Anthropic 3-5, OpenAI 1-3, Gemini 'experiment with the number' + overfit warning — a ranged rule (>=1, ~3 typical, up to 5 complex) is defensible; contradiction and plain-language checks verified verbatim.

REQ-010 validated and strengthened: every current Claude model has its own prompting page with measured differences (Opus 5 vs 5.5 diverge even on self-check instructions), OpenAI ships per-output-type meta-prompts, Gemini prescribes context-first/question-last + delimiter discipline — profiles should key to model versions, not just vendors.

REQ-011 validated almost verbatim: christabone 'aim for <3x original length' (150-300% typical) and its summary emits Added/Modified/Removed + Techniques-Applied/Skipped + confidence; OpenAI 'Preserve User Content ... entirely, or as closely as possible'.

REQ-007 direction validated but weakest-sourced: eval-first posture consistent with all verified sources and survey CONFIRMED rows (OpenAI optimizer >=3 graded rows; Evals API sunset dates), yet skill-creator/promptfoo/DSPy claims remain delegate readings — partially verified; CLEAR as short screen has sibling precedent.

Surveyed tools converge on visible-reasoning transparency (christabone <thinking> verdicts, severity1 injected-context visibility, sibling open items) — lighter than sk-prompt's proof-through-output metadata; the rebuild's report should carry change-list + open items + confidence.

Ranking verdict: REQ-002/003 correctly P0; REQ-004/005/006 strong; REQ-008 correct but re-aim artifact criterion; REQ-009 correct with softened example count; REQ-010 correct and upgraded by per-version pages; REQ-011 verbatim; REQ-007 right direction, weakest evidence + Evals sunset risk; none refuted.
